title: Signal Economy Ops — Weekly Notes and Action Items
body:
Purpose
Quick capture from Monday 3/28 signal-economy sync. Focus: tracing volume vs cost, dashboard ownership rotation, and next-step sampling experiments. Informal notes + action list for the week.

Attendees
Maya (note), Rajat, Ava, Liam, Sofia, (interrupts from infra: Ken)

TL;DR summary
- Trace ingestion spiked 18% last week (esp. canary region) and pushed monthly span budget toward alert threshold. Root cause: increased e2e debug spans from prod-canary tagging change.
- Short-term mitigation: temporary sampling bump + targeted pipeline filter for `debug.*` spans.
- Medium-term: implement dynamic sampling policy by route and cost-per-span heatmap; dashboard owners assigned for rollout metrics.
- Open decision: what retention/aggregation tradeoffs to request from product teams before end of Q2.

Notes / discussion points
1) Recent spike analysis (Rajat)
- Observed 18% spike week-on-week; 65% of the delta originates from two services in canary region (api-gateway and payments-proxy).
- Breakdowns: ~38% are debug-level spans (prefix `debug.`), 27% are high-cardinality SQL spans, rest are legitimate increase in user traffic.
- Hypothesis: a behind-the-scenes debug flag was toggled during staging deploy (linked OBS-789). Action: ask deployment owner (ENG-ops) for deploy timeline.

2) Immediate mitigations (Ava)
- Deployed a temporary sample rate increase (reduce inbound sampling from 100% -> 30%) for canary nets at the ingress agent level (30m window, rolling).
- Added a simple pipeline filter to drop spans with `debug.*` name and `internal=true` tag for 24 hours to buy time.
- Cost effect: estimated 11% reduction in projected monthly span bill if maintained. Need finance to confirm.

3) Sampling experiment plan (Liam)
- Experiment goal: keep tail latency observability for top 20 routes while reducing overall span cost 40%.
- Plan outline: per-route scorecard -> dynamic-adjust sampler with two knobs: `store_prob` and `retain_replay_window`.
- Metrics to capture: per-route p95/p99 trace latency, span count delta, error coverage (are we losing error traces?).
- Experiment timeline: start A/B on 4/6 for 2 weeks on 10% traffic. (WIP: define guardrails).

4) Dashboard hygiene and ownership (Sofia)
- Inventory: 14 dashboards flagged stale -> need scrub and update owners. Proposed rotation: 2-week rotation across eng-observability team; primary + backup model.
- Immediate: created a lightweight dashboard called `span-economy/heatmap` to show cost-per-span by service + route. Linked to PR for tiles.

5) Cost telemetry improvements
- Proposal: enrich traces with billing-dim tags (model_variant, region_tier) so cost allocation can tie to product lines.
- Risk: extra tags add cardinality. Proposal includes a low-cardinality canonicalization step in pipeline (map model_variant -> coarse bucket).

6) Runbook / Alerts update
- Existing span-budget alert currently fires at 75% of monthly budget; team suggests adding earlier soft alerts (50%, 65%) with paging only at 90%.
- Also suggested: add a trace-quality alert (drop in error-trace capture ratio > 15%) to avoid losing signal when sampling increases.

Unresolved questions / blockers
- Deploy owner confirmation for the debug flag toggle (ENG-ops ticket created, awaiting response).
- Finance confirmation on estimated cost reduction from temporary sample move. (Finance ask filed: FIN-OB-22)
- How much retention can product teams accept for full-span retention (90d vs 30d aggregated). Need product steer by 4/20.

Action items (owner — due)
- Rajat: correlate canary deploy timeline with span spikes; update OBS-789 with timeline + logs (due 2026-03-30).
- Ava: keep temporary pipeline filter and sampling in place; produce short P&L estimate for Finance (due 2026-03-31).
- Liam: write experiment spec for per-route dynamic sampler (include guardrails + abort criteria) and link PR (due 2026-04-02).
- Sofia: scrub stale dashboard list and assign owners; create onboarding note for rotation (due 2026-04-06).
- Maya: draft runbook change for soft alerts + trace-quality alert draft and circulate for review (due 2026-04-01).
- Ken (infra): help evaluate ingest-side canonicalization latency impact (<5ms goal) and run perf test (due 2026-04-05).

Follow-ups scheduled
- Quick sync Friday 4/2 10:30am PT to assess experiment readiness and confirm finance numbers.
- Post-mortem if spikes resume after mitigation window ends.

Notes to self / rough thoughts
- Consider a small internal metric: "span-efficiency" = useful_spans / total_spans by route. Could be a nice signal for automated sampling.
- We should prototype a low-cardinality tag mapping service that lives near the ingress collector.
- Consider linking sampling decisions to rollout flags in LaunchDarkly for fine-grained control per deploy.

References & quick links
- OBS-789 (Jira, spike investigation)
- PR #412 (heatmap dashboard tiles)
- Confluence: Signal Economy Playbook (draft)
- Slack: #observability for live run updates

Appendix: quick run numbers (rough)
- baseline daily spans: 4.2M -> 4.96M (this week's average)
- delta by category: debug 38%, sql-high-card 27%, traffic 35%
- cost impact w/ temporary filter: estimate -11% on projected span spend for month

End of notes — Maya

(If you pinged in the meeting and need a task assigned, add a comment and I'll slot it into the action item list.)
